values./system/description:
Made from the severed fingers and talons of a deathclaw and mounted on a cuff which fits over the wrist, these allow the wearer to strike with some of the lethal force of the claws’ previous owner.

A Deathclaw Gauntlet can accept the following mod which is installed with the Repair skill:

  • Deathclaw Gauntlet: Extra Claw
